title: copilot tools / Deploy the tested agent
content: ## Deploy the tested agent Deploy only after you have reviewed the generated code and checked its local behavior. Use [Deploy your hosted agent](/docs/intelligentapps/hosted-agents.md#deploy-your-hosted-agent) for the canonical deployment procedure and its source-code or container-image options. If you continue with {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %}, explicitly identify the tested project and intended deployment target: ```prompt Prepare this tested agent for deployment to my selected Foundry project. Review its deployment configuration, required identity permissions, packaged files, and secrets handling. Explain the resources and changes before deployment. ``` Preparing configuration does not submit a deployment. After you authorize deployment, confirm service-side success and test the deployed agent, rather than treating a local file change as success. Local sign-in does not transfer your user's permissions to the deployed agent. For service identity, publication, networking, and production operations, follow the [Foundry agent lifecycle](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/concepts/development-lifecycle). Publishing an agent application is separate from deploying hosted-agent code.
